summary: Implementation plan for building a Vietnamese company search tool. Compares 3 approaches (Google Places API, Masothue.com scraping, hybrid) across cost, data quality, and reliability. Recommends a 2-layer hybrid architecture: Google Places API (New) as primary source for real business data with 10K free requests/month, supplemented by masothue.com for tax/registration data enrichment. Outputs to Excel/CSV. Built in Python, stored in e:\TDC_App\TD_Consulting_App\Client_Search.
